svg.aria-label: Before: 28 small .set files in 14 folders, each folder labelled with a participant code from cba to wpa, two files per folder. After: a sketch of a table with rows for the participants cba, clm and ega and then a row of dots, the conditions animal and distractor as columns, and a narrow group column, F or M, in two colours. An arrow leads from the files to the table, and under it is one file named animal_mine.study.
